title: Cutting for Stone
author: Abraham Verghese
summary: Twin brothers are born in an Ethiopian mission hospital to a nun who dies in childbirth and a surgeon father who disappears. They grow up in the hospital, drawn to medicine and to the same woman, as the country changes around them.
readIf: you like generous, absorbing sagas set around a hospital, with a lot of medical detail and heart.
skipIf: you dislike graphic surgery scenes or want a book that moves quickly.

pairings.reason: The author's later novel, set in India, with the same patient pace, doctors and family secrets.
Another novel about brothers, betrayal and exile, with a more focused plot and a fast build-up.
Another moving story of lives shaped by political turmoil in a far-off country.
